verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound webhooks, event streams, or lifecycle hooks for sign-ups, sign-ins, or user changes. The homepage activity feed sample ("Sarah updated profile", "Mike enabled 2FA") is a marketing illustration of an activity view, not a subscribable callback or stream a programmatic consumer can receive. The axis applies to an auth framework, so the lack of evidence yields "none".

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to webhooks or event streams for auth events (sign-ups, sign-ins, user changes) to keep my systems in sync
